skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: The Dark Night Terminator
skins.content: Iteration Provident Series/The Dark Night Terminator. Crownslayer's iteration from decision point S/5258902. Dark clothes for an assassin. She grips her blade, determined to bring an end to the darkest corners of the city with her own hands.
skins.quote: 'This is the end you deserve for forcing the people to live in hatred and unease. Now fall. Hand your filthy soul over to the city pavement.'
